verse.verse_1: When the heaven is split asunder,
verse.verse_2: And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;
verse.verse_3: And when the earth is stretched forth,
verse.verse_4: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty,
verse.verse_5: And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;
verse.verse_6: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, so you will meet (i.e. the results of your deeds which you did).
verse.verse_7: Then, as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,
verse.verse_8: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,
verse.verse_9: And will return to his family in joy!
verse.verse_10: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,
verse.verse_12: And shall enter a blazing Fire, and made to taste its burning.
verse.verse_13: Verily, he was among his people in joy!
verse.verse_14: Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!
verse.verse_15: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!
verse.verse_16: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;
verse.verse_17: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness;
verse.verse_18: And by the moon when it is at the full,
verse.verse_19: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).
verse.verse_20: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?
verse.verse_21: And when the Quran is recited to them, they fall not prostrate,
verse.verse_22: Nay, (on the contrary), those who disbelieve, belie (Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him) and whatever he brought, i.e. this Quran and Islamic Monotheism, etc.).
verse.verse_23: And Allah knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),
verse.verse_24: So announce to them a painful torment.
verse.verse_25: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).
